# Pandey Urja LLP — Solar Solutions & Services

> Infinite Energy, Endless Trust. Complete Solar Solutions for Your Property.

Pandey Urja LLP is a full-service solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) and solar solutions provider headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India. The company takes end-to-end responsibility for solar projects for residential homes, housing societies, commercial properties, and industrial facilities.

## Core Identity
- **Brand Category:** Solar Solutions & Services
- **What We Do:** We plan, supply, install, and support solar systems.
- **Who We Serve:** Homes · Housing Societies · Commercial · Industrial
- **Core Philosophy:** "You come to us with your electricity requirement, and our single team takes care of the project from there."
- **Brand Position:** Not an environmental campaign, not just a panel dealer, and not just an installer. A single team taking complete responsibility for the solar project.

## Area Served
Surat, Bhestan, Vesu, Adajan, Katargam, Varachha, Pandesara, Sachin GIDC, Hazira, Navsari, Bardoli, Ankleshwar, Bharuch, and throughout South Gujarat.

## Our 5 Core Services

### 01. Solar Consultation
We check your electricity bills, sanctioned load, and property space to recommend the right capacity before you invest. Sized for your real consumption without inflating capacity.

### 02. Solar System Design
Complete system layout designed around your roof structure (RCC terrace, metal shed, elevated pergola) and appliances to maximize electricity generation across summer and winter.

### 03. Complete Equipment Supply
Direct supply of genuine, certified Tier-1 solar panels (Mono-PERC / TopCon), high-efficiency inverters, hot-dip galvanized mounting structures, and electrical BOS (cables, ACDB/DCDB, earthing).

### 04. Turnkey Installation & Grid Sync
Safe physical mounting without roof water leakage, dedicated chemical copper earthing pits, precision electrical wiring, testing, and DISCOM bidirectional net-meter synchronization (DGVCL / Torrent Power).

### 05. Solar Cleaning & Maintenance (AMC)
Routine de-mineralized water panel washing to restore 15%–25% lost generation, electrical diagnostics, inverter troubleshooting, and Annual Maintenance Contracts for new or existing plants.

## Four-Step Project Execution Approach
1. **Understand:** Review electricity bills, roof orientation, and property constraints first.
2. **Design:** Engineered system layout for peak solar yield.
3. **Execute:** Certified equipment, professional electrical installation, and safety testing.
4. **Support:** Net metering liaison, subsidy paperwork, routine cleaning, and lifetime AMC care.
